```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8,
                      dpi = 96)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(nordicepimight)
})
out <- params$out
inputs <- readRDS(file.path(out, "1_check", "inputs.rds"))
stratify <- inputs$study$stratify
analyses <- inputs$analyses
text_columns <- list(character = stratify)
read <- function(name) fread(file.path(out, name), colClasses = text_columns, na.strings = "NA")
h2 <- read("h2.tsv")
rg <- read("rg.tsv")
cif <- read("cif.tsv")
counts <- read("cohort_summary.tsv")
run <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(out, "run.yaml"))
heading <- function(level, text) cat("\n\n", strrep("#", level), " ", text, "\n\n", sep = "")
table_of <- function(d) print(knitr::kable(d, format = "html", table.attr = "class=\"table\""))
age_span <- function(lo, hi) ifelse(is.na(lo), "", ifelse(lo == hi, lo, paste(lo, hi, sep = "-")))
estimate_rows <- function(d, estimate) {
  d[, .(stratum = stratum_label(d, stratify), ages = age_span(age_min, age_max),
        estimate = format_estimate(get(estimate), l95_sandwich, u95_sandwich),
        se_native = signif(se_native, 3), note = ifelse(is.na(note), "", note))]
}
version_of <- function(pkg) {
  sprintf("%s (%s)", run$installed[[pkg]]$version, substr(run$installed[[pkg]]$commit, 1, 7))
}
```

# Run

```{r run, results = "asis"}
table_of(data.table(
  item = c("study population", "EPIMIGHT", "pedigreegraph", "R", "stratified by", "pooling",
           "EPIMIGHT calls", "warnings at check"),
  value = c(run$population,
            version_of("epimight"), version_of("pedigreegraph"),
            run$r_version, paste(stratify, collapse = ", "), run$settings$pooling,
            sprintf("%d (%d ok, %d expected stops)", run$epimight$calls, run$epimight$ok,
                    run$epimight$expected_stops),
            if (length(run$warnings) == 0) "none" else paste(names(run$warnings), collapse = ", "))
))
```

Estimates are shown with their pedigree-pair sandwich 95% interval; `se_native` is
EPIMIGHT's own standard error, for comparison.

# Analyses

```{r analyses, results = "asis", fig.height = 3.2}
for (k in seq_len(nrow(analyses))) {
  a <- analyses[k]
  if (a$analysis == "h2") {
    heading(2, sprintf("%s: h² of %s, %s", a$analysis_id, a$trait, a$relationship))
    rows <- h2[analysis_id == a$analysis_id]
    table_of(estimate_rows(rows, "h2"))
    print(plot_forest(rows, "h2", stratify))
    traits <- a$trait
  } else {
    heading(2, sprintf("%s: rg of %s on %s relatives with %s", a$analysis_id, a$trait,
                       a$relationship, a$relatives_trait))
    rows <- rg[analysis_id == a$analysis_id]
    table_of(estimate_rows(rows, "rg"))
    print(plot_forest(rows, "rg", stratify))
    traits <- c(a$trait, a$relatives_trait)
  }
  curves <- cif[analysis_id == a$analysis_id]
  if (nrow(curves) > 0) print(plot_cif(curves, stratify))
  table_of(counts[trait %in% traits & relatives_kind == a$relationship])
}
```

# h² by trait

```{r h2-forests, results = "asis", fig.height = 3.6}
for (t in unique(h2$trait)) {
  heading(2, t)
  print(plot_forest(h2[trait == t], "h2", stratify, colour = "relationship",
                    title = sprintf("h² of %s", t)))
}
```

# rg by relationship

```{r rg-heatmaps, results = "asis", fig.height = 4}
if (nrow(rg) == 0) cat("No rg analyses.\n")
for (r in unique(rg$relationship)) {
  heading(2, r)
  print(plot_rg_heatmap(rg, r))
}
```

# Summary

```{r summary, results = "asis"}
pooled_h2 <- h2[level == "pooled", .(analysis_id, estimate = "h2", traits = trait, relationship,
                                     strata = n_strata,
                                     value = format_estimate(h2, l95_sandwich, u95_sandwich),
                                     note = ifelse(is.na(note), "", note))]
pooled_rg <- rg[level == "pooled", .(analysis_id, estimate = "rg",
                                     traits = paste(index_trait, "on", relatives_trait),
                                     relationship, strata = n_strata,
                                     value = format_estimate(rg, l95_sandwich, u95_sandwich),
                                     note = ifelse(is.na(note), "", note))]
table_of(rbind(pooled_h2, pooled_rg))
```
